task.title: Unknown non-GET paths return 200 with the app's HTML
task.body:
Forge answers a POST, PUT, or DELETE to any unknown path outside `/api/` with `200 OK` and the app's HTML, so a mistyped mutation looks like it worked. `kenn-forge api DELETE <path>` then prints the page and exits 0.

The SPA fallback in `internal/server/compression/spa_handler.go` should serve `index.html` only for GET and HEAD, and return 404 (or 405) for other methods. Browser navigation only ever sends GET, so the fallback loses nothing.

Reproduce on v0.4.0-73-g642b9c89d (same handler on `main` at e64c88ff8):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:8091/repo/github/owner/name
200
```

I hit this from Git Bash on Windows, which rewrites a leading-slash argument to a native exe into a Windows path (`/api/v1/repo/...` becomes `C:/Program Files/Git/api/v1/repo/...`). The request left `/api/`, landed on the fallback, and came back 200, so a repo removal looked done while nothing changed. `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` gets the real 404 or 204.
